{{Quote|Arno, go get my imager. I want a holo of myself with the prisoner.|[[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Lesim]] requests a picture with [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] after the rebel surrendered on Endor|<ref name="Capture">{{WEGCite|story=The Capture of Luke Skywalker|book=Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi|reprint=1}}</ref>}}
An '''imager''' was a device that one could use to take [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] images of people and places.<ref name="Capture" /> Two synchronized imagers were used to scan a subject when a [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] recording was created, with a [[Computer/Legends|computer]] combining the recording to generator a full three-dimensional image.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

[[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Lesim]] requested such a device after the surrender of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], famed [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] hero, so that the former could take a holo of the event.<ref name="Capture" />

[[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]] used a handheld imager to take an image of [[Derek Klivian/Legends|Derek Klivian]] in his [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]].<ref name="Shadows">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref>
